gold_sql: SELECT d.id FROM departments d WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM employees e WHERE e.dept_id = d.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM employees e WHERE e.dept_id = d.id AND (e.bonus IS NULL OR e.bonus <= 300))

gold_sql: SELECT d.id FROM departments d WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM employees e WHERE e.dept_id = d.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM employees e WHERE e.dept_id = d.id AND (e.bonus IS NULL OR e.bonus <= 200))
